venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 1/11.** Tipsy-turvy but normal flow with many big parties, mostly retail software developers at a nearby conference. More reservations helped mid-sized parties and shifted the night from date-night flow to a more varied mix. Favorite table: Louisiana guests enjoying coursed shaken-vs-stirred pairs (Swiss Army Knife vs Silver Monk). Decent close from two large parties, one drinking Macallan 15. Top sellers: Masari, First Time Listener, Year of the Trees. Door: felt like a Wednesday; line at open but not full until the 8pm turn; a conference party invited double digits more friends than could be accommodated; cold kept people away, died out ~11:30. No-shows: Andrea Walker 2 @ 6pm (couldn't charge); Eric Yoon 2 @ 8pm (charged). Kitchen: great job.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Was a nice day early on but quickly turned cold and windy
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Sunday 1/11.** Very quiet Sunday at the 124. Skeleton crew but two bartenders from the start; finished slightly above sales goal. Let Jada go ~9 and Ian closed the bar solo (shoutout to Eric for helping him break down). Natural close with a few industry friends at last call. Kitchen: just a few plates, great night for oysters; slightly above 12% of sales. MOD: Jamal.
